title: US bank branch count

source.name: FDIC Summary of Deposits; branch-count trend analysis
source.publisher: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC); Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond

notes: US bank branch count peaked at 99,550 in 2009. FDIC data put it at 94,725 by mid-2014. The Richmond Fed reports total closures have outpaced openings every year since 2010, with the branch count falling by roughly 20,000 from the 2009 peak; the 2024 figure here (79,550) is derived from that reported decline, not a separately cited exact total.
